title: Deviation inequalities for U-processes of growing order, with applications to half-space depth
summary: We prove new deviation inequalities for infinite-order U-processes, that is, U-processes whose order may increase with the sample size. Our goal is to obtain the sharpest possible dependence of the tail bounds on the order of the process, as well as to characterize the largest range in which the process exhibits sub-Gaussian deviations. We derive closed-form inequalities for processes indexed by Euclidean classes, including VC-subgraph classes of functions.
